_doc: Rule profiles = named operating points of the wave-3 confirmation entry (docs/RULESET.md). Every knob cites its rule basis; [free] knobs are the research-sweep surface (docs/FULL_AUTOMATION_ROADMAP.md, research track). The strict<->experimental spread reproduces wavelib.wave3.wave3_signal_strict / wave3_signal exactly.

experimental._doc: The crude-but-proven skeleton (+0.17..+0.44R, docs/WAVE3_RESULT.md). R1/A-1/B-1/C-1 only.

sow_neowave_soft._doc: First sweep point between crude and strict: strands>=2, R:R>=1.5, pattern-ID on.

sow_neowave_strict._doc: Rule-faithful per RULESET SH: NeoWave :5 pattern-ID (02 S2.1) + confluence >=3 strands (Table D) + R:R>=2 (E-2) + E-10 entry window + S&B time budget. High per-trade R, few trades.

classic_elliott._doc: Classical Elliott validation posture: hard rules mandatory, guidelines advisory; golden-zone W2, momentum on, single confluence strand minimum, R:R>=2 (practitioner E-2).
